distribution.title:
The purpose of the data collection/generation in the project is to support evidence-based decision-making for the development of the education system and achieving strategic educational development goals. Specifically, data is collected to:
  • Profile Educational Leadership and Management (EL&M) Practices: This includes analyzing thinking and action models, values, and beliefs of teachers, school leaders, and local education authorities to identify gaps in competencies that hinder effective school improvement.
  • Evaluate Current Practices and Needs: Conduct a situational analysis to assess existing approaches and professional development programs for building EL&M capacity, identifying enablers and barriers to educational innovations.
  • Develop Tools and Frameworks: Create descriptive frameworks, measurement instruments, and a data-driven toolkit for profiling EL&M practices and school improvement gap analysis.
  • Design and Test Solutions: Pilot customized professional development programs tailored to address competency gaps and enhance the capacity of education professionals for school improvement.
  • Monitor and Validate Reforms: Gather evidence on the readiness of educational professionals to implement innovations and monitor changes in classroom practices aligned with reforms, especially those promoting student-centered learning​.

dmp.description: Data management plan is developed to ensures that research data of the project "Operational framework to support capacity building of educational professionals for school improvement solution development in schools and municipalities" is handled efficiently, securely, and ethically, while meeting all necessary requirements and facilitating future use. The data management plan includes a detailed description of several datasets that will be acquired during the project.

project.description: To build the capacity of teachers, school leadership, and municipal education specialists for effective management of change and innovation, enhancement of school performance, education quality management, and strengthening of a student-centered approach. The task for achieving this goal involves the research and profiling of thinking and action models (including beliefs, convictions, and values) of teachers, school leadership, and municipal education specialists, as well as the development of solutions for their growth and improvement.
